reviews.text: I bought this because I really loved the packaging but I wasn’t expecting the smell to be so nice I really love this. Smell very fresh and delicate.
reviews.zh: 因為好鍾意包裝所以買咗，但係冇想到味道咁好聞，我真係好鍾意。味道好清新、好細緻。

reviews.text: i bought the pink one and i adore the smell, it's so sweet yet fresh. the bottle is just plastic, but it's very cute and looks nice on the shelf. the smell, however, does not last on the skin for longer than two hours.
reviews.zh: 我買咗粉紅色嗰款，我好鍾意佢嘅味道，甜但又清新。樽身淨係係膠嘅，但係好可愛，放喺櫃上都好靚。不過，味道喺皮膚上唔會持續超過兩個鐘。

reviews.text: Caramel Bear has a deliciously sweet, warm and cosy scent with a soft gourmand feel. It’s perfect if you love sugary, dessert-like fragrances without wanting something too heavy. The adorable bear bottle is also absolutely gorgeous and makes it feel like a little collectible.
reviews.zh: Caramel Bear 有一種甜美、温暖、舒適嘅香味，帶少少柔和嘅甜點感。如果你鍾意甜甜、似甜品嘅香水，但又唔想太濃，就好啱。可愛嘅小熊樽身都好靚，令人覺得好似一件小收藏品。

reviews.text:
Parfum lacté et gourmand. Le musc permet de garder une certaine fraîcheur. Il a une odeur de caramel lacté avec un soupçon de propre. La tenue semble correcte.
J’ai retiré une étoile car la partie haute du gâteau était décollée de la bouteille. J’ai pu la recoller sans soucis.
reviews.zh:
奶香同美食感嘅香水。麝香令香味保持一定嘅清新感。佢有奶味焦糖嘅香氣，帶少少乾淨感。持久度似乎正常。
我扣咗一粒星，因為個蛋糕頂部同樽身脫咗膠，我後來無難度就黏返。

reviews.text: i got both scents, and first of all the honey lemon is SO GOOD. i wasn't expecting to like it as much as i did but it was a beautifully sweet fresh fruity scent. the caramel bear one i found on me didn't smell that much like caramel, it was more like a kinda sweet/milky shampoo scent? also the bottom bit of the bottle that has the brand/scent info etc (the little bottom-most frosting part of the design) wasn't glued on properly and falls off easily. giving this overall 4/5 stars for that, might've bumped it down to 3 stars if i only got the caramel bear but the honey lemon is wonderful enough to carry my review up to 4 stars
reviews.zh: 兩個味我都試咗，首先蜂蜜檸檬真係好好聞！我本來冇諗過會咁鍾意，但佢係一種好甜、清新、果香嘅味道。至於 caramel bear，我喺自己身上聞到嘅唔係好似焦糖，而係有啲似甜甜嘅奶香洗頭水味？另外，樽底最底嗰層磨砂設計部分（即係寫住品牌同香味資料嗰部分）冇貼好，容易跌落。因此我畀咗 4/5 星，如果我得咗 caramel bear 嘅話可能會減到 3 星，但係蜂蜜檸檬已經好到足以將我嘅評價提升到 4 星。

reviews.text: this is the second time I buy this. I buy one in Valentine time for my mom and she love it. she using it very day. the smell very match to my mom personality. I buy another for restock
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第二次買。情人節嗰陣買咗一支畀媽媽，佢好鍾意。佢每日都用。個味好啱我媽媽嘅性格。我再買多一支做後備。

reviews.text: The smell is super sweet; it will make you feel like you are in a desert for the rest of the day. Be aware it its REALLY sweet. I really like it and am very happy with the smell. It's a clear vanilla smell which is very alliterated with the caramel smell. This makes it stand out from other perfumes and gives it a warm feeling.
reviews.zh: 味道超級甜；會令你成日都好似身處沙漠咁，成日都好甜。留意佢真係好甜。我真係好鍾意，對個味道好滿意。係一種清晰嘅香草味，同焦糖味好夾。咁就令佢同其他香水有啲唔同，帶嚟一種暖暖嘅感覺。

reviews.text:
The best fragrance I’ve ever tried.
A light, delicate caramel scent that feels absolutely divine. It’s warm, elegant, and irresistibly addictive — truly wow. I completely fell in love from the very first moment. A beautifully balanced perfume that feels both comforting and luxurious. ✨
reviews.zh:
我試過最好嘅香水。
一種輕盈、精緻嘅焦糖香味，感覺絕對好正。佢暖暖、優雅，又令人好上癮——真係好驚艷。我一見到就完全愛上咗。一款平衡得好好嘅香水，既有安慰感，又有奢華感。✨

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
